data.title: Emlak Konut Advances Ümraniye İnkılap Project with First Tender Session
data.description:
Emlak Konut Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Ag ( (TR:EKGYO) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Emlak Konut Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklığı A.Ş. has advanced the İstanbul Ümraniye İnkılap 2nd Stage Project by holding the first tender session under a revenue sharing in return for land sale model, in cooperation with Türksat Uydu Haberleşme Kablo TV ve İşletme A.Ş. data.title: Regeneron Steps Into Obesity Drug Race With New Phase 1 Study
data.description:
Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) announced an update on their ongoing clinical study.

Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (REGN) is running a Phase 1 study called “A Phase 1, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of the Safety, Tolerability, and Pharmacokinetics of Single Ascending Doses of REGN20934 in Adult Participants With Overweight or Obesity.” The goal is to check safety and early drug behavior in the body, laying groundwork for Regeneron’s push into the fast-growing obesity treatment market.

The study tests REGN20934, an injectable drug candidate aimed at adults with overweight or obesity. It is designed to help manage weight over time if later trials confirm benefits, positioning Regeneron as a potential new player alongside established obesity drug leaders.

Participants are randomly assigned to REGN20934 or placebo, so comparisons are fair and unbiased. The trial is double-blind, meaning neither patients nor most study staff know who gets the real drug, and it focuses mainly on safety and how the drug moves through the body.

The study was first submitted on May 11, 2026, marking the formal start of the clinical path for this asset. The listing was last updated on September 23, 2026, showing that the protocol details and recruitment status are current and that the program is actively managed.

For investors, this early-stage obesity study adds optionality to REGN’s pipeline at a time when demand for weight-loss drugs is reshaping pharma valuations. Success would support a longer-term growth story and help Regeneron compete with leaders like Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly, though near-term stock impact will likely be modest until later-phase efficacy data emerge.

The REGN20934 study in overweight and obesity remains active and updated, with more information available on the ClinicalTrials.gov portal under NCT07594093.
